subject.title: feat(feishu): native Markdown for inbound content_v2 & outbound tag:md

question: Should Feishu upgrades preserve the current `renderMode: auto` and `markdown.tableMode` behavior, or intentionally switch existing users to native post Markdown by default?
rationale: Both behaviors are shipped configuration contracts, while current Feishu APIs support native GFM Markdown; choosing the permanent default and upgrade policy requires owner intent rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Preserve shipped behavior
options.body: Keep auto card routing and table conversion effective, land inbound `content_v2` separately, and use existing explicit settings for native posts.

options.title: Approve native-by-default migration
options.body: Intentionally change the defaults, deprecate or remove the now-inert settings, document upgrade impact, and prove both fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve shipped behavior
recommendation.body: Keep auto card routing and table conversion effective, land inbound `content_v2` separately, and use existing explicit settings for native posts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership of the Feishu reply-dispatcher and streaming/card delivery boundary.
